opening.argument: The description pairs concrete monetary benefits with explicit actions through the speaker's links. Viewers are offered a $20 bonus and a reward card worth up to $1,000 through a ByBit invite URL, while Binance promises a 5% trading-fee reduction if they sign up through the speaker's link. That is not merely discussion of crypto; it is a reward-and-action funnel embedded alongside the video. The exact eligibility conditions, qualification steps, and limitations of the large reward-card claim are not established, making the solicitation materially difficult to assess before clicking or registering.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the offers separate referral promotions does not remove the central issue: each benefit is expressly connected to an external link or registration action. The description places them directly beside crypto-purchase links and a bullish XLM discussion, so the audience is being given concrete reasons to enter financial platforms. A disclaimer does not explain the reward conditions or make the solicitation non-deceptive.
